page.layout: One title page. Centred printed lines from top to bottom: author's name, title in large capitals, a short subtitle, a Latin line with a dedication-like phrase, small lines of place and printer, a central ornament, then the printer's and the date lines at the foot. No margins with text.
page.notes: Show-through from the reverse is faint in the middle and lower half, so several lines are only partly readable and are marked illegible. The large title word reads MANDVCATIONE with possible final letters unclear. The engraved ornament (a central device with a banner) is not transcribed. The date line and the printer's name are uncertain. The small italic lines of the subtitle and the place-of-printing lines are too faint to copy letter by letter.
